_note: K4: trades, deaths and opening duels (src/coach/derive/positioning, docs/coach/utility.md).

trades._window: A kill trades a teammate's death when its victim is that teammate's killer and it comes within windowSec of the death.
trades._distance: A teammate could have traded when he was alive within tradeDistance units (horizontal) of the victim at the death tick. 900 covers 8 of the 9 trades in the test demo (traders were 101–1,017 units from the victim); the lobby's nearest-teammate distribution is in docs/coach/utility.md.
trades._los: With a sight mesh: rows sampled every losStepTicks inside the trade window; a teammate 'had sight' of the killer when any body point is visible from his eye (smokes ignored).

untradeable._detector: Deaths with no living teammate within tradeDistance that were not traded (rounds where the player was the last alive are excluded). Fix: at least minInstances such deaths, and a share of deaths >= share.

missed._detector: A teammate died within tradeDistance of the player while the player was alive with a gun; a miss is no damage to the killer inside the window (opportunities traded by another teammate are not misses). Fix: at least minMissed misses and a miss share >= share.

opening._detector: Fix 'losing openings': at least minDuels opening duels and a win rate <= maxWinRate. Fix 'CT dies first pushing': first deaths as CT within earlySec of freeze end at a position closer to the T spawn than pushProgress (0 = CT spawn, 1 = T spawn; spawns are the sides' mean positions at freeze end); at least minPushDeaths. Strength: at least minDuels and win rate >= strengthWinRate.

clock._round: Seconds of play after freeze end (CS2: 1:55) for the round clock in the deaths table.

scoring._impact: Fights per instance: an untraded death with nobody in range half a fight, a missed trade one, an opening duel lost beyond an even split one, a CT first death pushing one.
